note: Medical text corrections. ECG: V3 sits midway between V2 and V4; aVF is the LEFT leg, the RIGHT leg is the ground; leads II/III use the left leg. Neonatal CPR: 3:1 compression-to-breath ratio (about 90 compressions + 30 breaths per minute), compressions when HR stays < 60/min after 30 s of effective ventilation.

fixes.to: V3 midway between V2 and V4

fixes.from: aVF (right leg), and Lead I (right arm with left arm), Lead II (right arm with leg), Lead III (left arm with leg) — the left leg electrode is a ground connection only
fixes.to: aVF (left leg), and Lead I (right arm with left arm), Lead II (right arm with left leg), Lead III (left arm with left leg) — the right leg electrode is a ground (neutral) connection only
